title: Thai ‘Fathers for Hire’ citizenship fraud probe leads to 46 warrants

blocks.text: BANGKOK — Police and the Department of Provincial Administration have expanded their investigation into a “Fathers for Hire” network that used Thai men to falsely acknowledge paternity of children born to foreign nationals so the children could obtain Thai citizenship unlawfully.
